# Upgrade SpecLoops Core v0.1.7-beta → v0.1.8-beta

## Rule

> **Upgrade the rules; do not reset the campaign.**

## Preserve

Preserve all project-owned context, `SPECLOOPS_STATE.md`, Working Spec, Question Ledgers, named DRAFT/APPROVED specs, handoffs, evidence, application code/tests, campaign/quest progress, authority, rejected directions, non-goals and history.

## Add/update

- Update installed Core protocol to v0.1.8-beta.
- Add `ATLAS_OPERATING_MODEL.md` or equivalent local durable rules.
- Update managed agent instructions with Atlas/Campaign/Specialist governance.
- Do not synthesize historical Atlas facts. Existing project Atlas initialization is Reality-First Reconstruction: observe reality, mark OBSERVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN, ask only material confirmation questions, then promote governed truth.

## Resume

After upgrade:

1. establish live repository/ref/HEAD;
2. reconcile any Build Room result before following stale cursor instructions;
3. resume the same campaign/quest/question position;
4. do not change implementation authority unless separately approved.
